header.sentence: At a 35% photo drop rate, 104 homes a month never reach the fleet that guided collection at 15% would keep. That is $21,646 a month of compute margin never scheduled.

panels.name: Territory and lead
panels.unit: share of leads resolved to a served territory, owner, with an address
panels.ceiling: Base's own eligibility rules; unknown to us
assumptions: leads drawn by zip in proportion to permit volume (49 Austin zips, Undervolt extract)
territory: house/territory.py lookup(); served = energy_and_backup, backup_only (Austin Energy, Backup Only plan), or mixed (competitive TDU in part of the zip)
zips missing from territory.py ZIP_TABLE count as unmapped, not served; territory_only_share ignores tenure and new builds
new-build share drives 'no address yet' (Base's head of software: homes still being built have no address)

panels.name: Photo step
panels.unit: share of leads that never complete the panel photos
panels.ceiling: Base's real drop rate; ask Saturday
assumptions: drop rate is a dial, default from the funnel walk
state machine asked/reminded/partial not modelled yet

panels.name: Permit permutations
panels.unit: distinct territory x tenure x equipment paths observed
panels.ceiling: Base's head of software: 'in the hundreds, will probably get into thousands' with fire and electrical codes
assumptions: STUB: 3 axes only; fire code and electrical code axes not added

panels.name: Install routing
panels.ceiling: a real VRP solver; greedy is the floor

panels.name: Fleet
panels.unit: $ fleet margin over 3 days, power plus compute
panels.ceiling: MILP on real telemetry; greedy on three historical days is the floor. Say replication.
assumptions: grid price: ERCOT DAM, Austin Energy load zone (LZ_AEN), three real days 2026-09-07, 09-09, 09-26; no replay
STUB demand: buyers take 40% of GPU node-hours (jobs plus marketplace); member self-use capped at 25% of a node's hours. No telemetry; both are dials (--util, --member-cap)
compute_members = member tier, homeowners paying $1.20/h for jobs on their own node; compute_outside = every other buyer

sourced: buyer rates per GPU hour: member 1.20 (local job rate, fixed, unchanged), business 1.09 (Lambda A6000 on-demand, reliable dedicated cloud), base 0.79 (RunPod community L40S, Base's own batch work on spot capacity), partner 0.34 (RunPod community RTX 4090), external 0.16 (RunPod community RTX A5000, cheapest public marketplace batch). See grid/RATES.md.
scheduler: greedy with 24h day-ahead lookahead (top-4 hours discharge, bottom-6 charge)
recovery = hours until the hourly margin is back to 95% of the same hour with no kill; components return after 3
